description: Break the STRING MFF-DRP-1 edge into evidence channels and plot it next to the GO annotation-support inventory for worm and human MFF
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session()
CH=[('nscore','neighborhood'),('fscore','fusion'),('pscore','co-occurrence'),
    ('ascore','coexpression'),('escore','experiments'),('dscore','databases'),('tscore','textmining')]
rows=[]
for ident,lbl in [('F11C1.2','mff-1'),('F55F8.6','mff-2')]:
    n=S.get('https://string-db.org/api/json/network',
            params={'identifiers':ident,'species':6239,'required_score':150},timeout=30).json()
    for e in n:
        a,b=e['preferredName_A'],e['preferredName_B']
        if 'drp-1' in (a+b).lower():
            rows.append(dict(query=lbl,A=a,B=b,combined=float(e['score']),
                             **{name:float(e.get(k,0)) for k,name in CH}))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).drop_duplicates()
pd.set_option('display.width',200)
print('=== STRING evidence channels for the MFF-drp-1 edge in C. elegans ===')
print(df.to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv('string_mff_drp1_channels.csv',index=False)

best=df.sort_values('combined',ascending=False).groupby('query').head(1).set_index('query')
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.2))
names=[c[1] for c in CH]
x=np.arange(len(names)); w=0.38
for i,q in enumerate(['mff-1','mff-2']):
    ax[0].bar(x+(i-0.5)*w,[best.loc[q,c] for c in names],w,label=f'{q} - drp-1')
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(names,rotation=35,ha='right')
ax[0].set_ylabel('STRING sub-score'); ax[0].set_ylim(0,1)
ax[0].set_title('STRING evidence channels, C. elegans MFF - DRP-1')
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8); ax[0].axhline(0.4,ls=':',c='grey',lw=1)

# right panel: GO evidence-code inventory
inv=pd.DataFrame({'protein':['Ce MFF-1','Ce MFF-2','Hs MFF'],
                  'IEA':[5,6,34-6-5-0],'experimental (IDA/IPI/IMP)':[0,0,6],'other manual':[0,0,5]})
inv=pd.DataFrame({'Ce MFF-1':[5,0],'Ce MFF-2':[6,0],'Hs MFF':[12,22]},index=['IEA only','manual / experimental']).T
inv.plot(kind='barh',stacked=True,ax=ax[1],color=['#bbbbbb','#2c7fb8'])
ax[1].set_xlabel('number of GO annotations'); ax[1].set_title('GO annotation support (QuickGO)')
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
for i,(p,r) in enumerate(inv.iterrows()):
    ax[1].text(r.sum()+0.4,i,f'MF terms: {"0" if "Ce" in p else "3 (0005515, 0042802, 0042803)"}',va='center',fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_xlim(0,48)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
